name: refracted-text
title: Refracted Text
description: Glass letters with an optional character lift, adjustable opening flow, customizable top and bottom colors, original font contours and a refracted beam.

@font-face {
  font-family: 'ReactDrops Librestile';
  src: url('data:font/woff2;base64,') format('woff2');
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-display: swap;
}

.refracted-text {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  width: min(100%, var(--refracted-width));
  max-width: 100%;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.refracted-text canvas {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.refracted-text__fallback {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: currentColor;
  font-size: 0.8em;
  font-weight: 900;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
